label: Design rules and stitching
subgoals: Check clocks, resets and loops against the scan design rules
Group flops into chains by clock domain and edge
Insert lockup latches where a chain crosses domains

label: Balancing
subgoals: Divide the flops by the chains and round up for the balanced length
Read the test time from the longest chain
Compare cycles for the unbalanced and balanced longest chains

label: Choosing the chain count
subgoals: Write the cycle count as a function of chain count
Increase the chain count until the cycles meet the budget
Turn to compression when scan pins run out
